props.gloss_en: Rav: kilkul [of R' Yehuda's measure] is the tzida
Rav: andifi [of R' Nechemya's measure] is the bat-tzida
we hold that the Rabbis' measure [of lime] is greater [than R' Yehuda's]
Rebbi: R' Yehuda's words appear [right] for chavut lime
Rebbi: and R' Nechemya's words for a beitza of lime
the school of R' Ami (via R' Yitzchak): [R' Nechemya's andifi is lime] on the andifa
Rav Kahana: rather, [the lime of the andifa is for] markings
the mishna: there were markings on the hin -- up to here for a bull, up to here for a ram, up to here for a lamb
and if you like, say: what is andifa? the forehead
asked to expound Ma'aseh Merkava, the Galilean said: I will expound to you as R' Nechemya expounded to his colleague
a hornet came out of the wall and struck him on his andifei, and he died
and they said of him: from his own, this [came] to him

supports.gloss_en: כדתנן: שנתות היו בהין -- עד כאן לפר, עד כאן לאיל, עד כאן לכבש
וכי הא דההוא בר גליל... ונפקא ערעיתא מן כותלא ומחתיה באנדיפי ומית -- the hornet struck him on his andifei

objections.gloss_en: למימרא דשיעורא דרבי יהודה נפיש? הא קיימא לן דשיעורא דרבנן נפיש! -- is that to say R' Yehuda's measure is greater? but we hold the Rabbis' measure is greater

answered_by.gloss_en: זוטא מדרבנן, ונפיש מדרבי נחמיה -- [R' Yehuda's] is smaller than the Rabbis' and greater than R' Nechemya's

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי, אמר רבי: נראין דברי רבי יהודה בחבוט ודברי רבי נחמיה בביצת הסיד; ואי סלקא דעתך צידעא ובת צידעא, אידי ואידי חבוט? -- if they were the tzida and the bat-tzida, both would be chavut
מתקיף לה רב כהנא: וכי אדם עושה מעותיו אנפרות?! -- does a man turn his money into a loss?

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אמר רב כהנא: שנתות -- rather, markings (= p_rk_shenatot)
ואיבעית אימא: מאי אנדיפא -- אפותא -- andifa is the forehead (= p_andifa_aputa)
